strings.name: Jay-Z
strings.summary: Born Shawn Carter, Jay-Z built intricate rap narratives from his Brooklyn upbringing. Reasonable Doubt, The Blueprint and 4:44 explore urban life, success and self-examination. He co-founded a record label and established Roc Nation, extending into artist and sports management. His history includes legal controversy: a sexual-assault civil suit was withdrawn in 2025, and its claimant recanted in a 2026 sworn declaration.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His rap writing and music-industry work have lasting influence; his records portray urban experience, shifting identities and Black culture.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Rap storytelling
strings.highlights.h1.text: Complex language, flow and urban experience give his work lasting influence.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Music-industry practice
strings.highlights.h2.text: From Roc-A-Fella to Roc Nation, worked in records, artist management and sport.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Litigation developments
strings.timeline.t1.text: The claimant recanted assault allegations under oath; his California claims against her lawyer remained dismissed.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Civil suit withdrawn
strings.timeline.t2.text: The claimant withdrew her suit against him and Sean Combs; withdrawal was not a merits trial judgment.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Rock Hall induction
strings.timeline.t4.text: Released an album exploring self-examination and family relationships.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founded Roc Nation
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established a company spanning music and artist management.
strings.timeline.t6.title: The Black Album
strings.timeline.t6.text: Released the album and temporarily announced retirement from solo recording.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Album and legal case
strings.timeline.t7.text: Released The Blueprint; pleaded guilty over a 1999 stabbing and received probation.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Debut album
strings.timeline.t8.text: Released Reasonable Doubt through Roc-A-Fella, building an independent distribution base.
